description: American Electric Power Company was incorporated under the laws of the State of New York in 1906 and reorganized in 1925, and is a public utility holding company that directly owns all of the outstanding common stock of its public utility subsidiaries. The service areas of those subsidiaries cover portions of Arkansas, Indiana, Kentucky, Louisiana, Michigan, Ohio, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia and West Virginia, and they have traditionally provided electric service, consisting of generation, transmission and distribution, on an integrated basis to retail customers, with restructuring laws in Michigan, Ohio and the ERCOT area of Texas causing previously integrated regulated rates to be unbundled in those states.
